inference_substrate.principle: Aggregation capstone — reads upstream JSONs, performs no live LLM inference; duration floor = 0.0001 s.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed_/shipped_ to avoid false-positive partial classification.

paper_v6_safe_claims.principle: Lists only claims that survive the Paper-v6 Narrowing Discipline; excluded: retracted claims #2-#11 and the 4-verifier/k=15 conflation.

paper_v6_forbidden_claims.principle: Documents exactly which retracted claims must not appear in any forward-facing artifact or paper section.

g2.principle: G2 is unmet until a non-operator runs scripts/reproduce_fover_headline.py from a fresh clone and confirms both CI bounds.  Internal CI pass (exp3419) advances G2 but does not close it.
